name: EPICYKLOS
author: Javier Sánchez (Cyklos)
tagline: dub techno, ambient and drone instrument for the FM-1
description: Work in progress: a six-track dub techno, ambient and drone instrument for the M-VAVE FM-1. Phase 1: six tracks of a test voice on an euclidean sequencer, the orbit and mixer views.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments).
